period: Track record from ECMWF AIFS ENS 00 UTC runs of 13 May to 5 November 2026, checked against NASA IMERG Late V07C for 14 May to 10 November 2026. 177 runs over six months, most of them monsoon, so it says little about winter.
wording: agreed with the satellite estimate, never correct (SPEC 5.9)
luck_wording: slightly better than the usual rain for this place and month, but the difference could be luck
crps_disagrees_wording: the two scores point different ways here: one of them beats its baseline and the other does not. The label follows the Brier score, and this is said rather than hidden
crps_baseline: the observed daily totals at that square over the 30 days ending the day before the run

frequency_check.wording: the model says this much rain more often than the satellite sees it
frequency_check.ratio: mean forecast over observed frequency; above 1 means the model said it more often than the satellite saw it
